resources.string: Connect to a computer over USB
ADB needs the OTG port to act as a device for a computer, not as a host for accessories.
Do not do this if your console has Wi-Fi built in, such as the R36XX: it uses this same USB port for its Wi-Fi, which then stops working until you restart.
Never do this while the console is charging from its other port. Unplug the charger first.
The OTG port could not switch to a computer. If a charger is plugged in, unplug it and try again.
No stock backup for this CID found.
Backup hashes will be checked before any eMMC write.
Start recovery from an SD card with dw_mmc_rockchip.builtin_emmc=1 to enable the eMMC.
To restore, start recovery from SD. Recovery on the eMMC cannot restore itself.
Overwrite ALL eMMC partitions, apps and data?
Connect a charger. Do not power off or remove storage.
Restoring stock eMMC. Keep the charger connected.
Stock eMMC restored and read back successfully.
Stock data restored, but the boot areas could not be confirmed as stock.
Restore did not complete. Keep the backup and retry from SD recovery.
The eMMC helper failed or returned no result. Its prebuilt may need rebuilding.
